name: Misplaced Blocks
hint: The finder detects blocks that are used on the wrong actor type: sprite-only blocks such as motion, appearance, clone, or visibility blocks on the stage, and stage-only backdrop blocks on a sprite. Such blocks cannot affect the intended actor and may be ignored or behave unexpectedly.
instruction: Move the script or the affected block to the actor type it supports, or replace it with an equivalent block that is available for the current actor.
